title: Transform of a Boolean sign function
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and encode signs by bits with $+1$ represented by $0$ and $-1$ by $1$. The function on the bit cube given by $x\mapsto(1-f((-1)^{x_1},\ldots,(-1)^{x_n}))/2$ equals the indicator that the bit encoding of $f((-1)^{x_1},\ldots,(-1)^{x_n})$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the sign cube
